containerDefinitions.name: idle
command:
import time,signal,sys,json
def stop(signum,frame):
 print(json.dumps({'event':'signal-exit','at':time.time(),'signal':signum}),flush=True)
 sys.exit(0)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)
print(json.dumps({'event':'idle-started','at':time.time()}),flush=True)
while time.time()<1789615033:
 time.sleep(1)
print(json.dumps({'event':'absolute-deadline-exit','at':time.time()}),flush=True)
